2607.08602.title: Towards Precision Therapy in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Clinical-Reasoning LLM for Risk Stratification and Treatment Guidance
2607.08602.paper_summary: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a common malignancy and a leading cause of cancer-related mortality. Current guidelines and staging systems provide coarse categories, but often miss within-stage heterogeneity and the clinical context in electronic medical records (EMRs). We present HCC-STAR (Hepatocellular Carcinoma Staging, Treatment And pRognosis), a clinically aligned large language model that reads routine EMR narratives and jointly outputs risk score-based staging, ranked guideline-consistent treatments with evidence-based rationales, and individualized survival estimates. We curated about 30,000 HCC cases from SEER and expanded them into EMR-style narrative training data using a clinician-validated, prompt-based augmentation workflow. On this corpus, we developed a knowledge-aligned reasoning framework optimized with a step-verifiable composite reward, moving beyond text-level memorization of clinical guidelines. In a multi-center cohort of 6,668 patients from 12 hospitals in China, HCC-STAR achieved state-of-the-art performance in treatment recommendation and risk stratification compared with clinical guidelines and competitive models, including GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5 Pro. Hypothetical overall-survival analysis showed a median survival of 51 months under adherence to HCC-STAR recommendations, compared with 29 and 32 months under BCLC and CNLC. In clinician-centric evaluations, blinded hepatobiliary specialists rated HCC-STAR's reasoning and evidence-based justifications as trustworthy. The model surpassed resident and attending physicians in treatment accuracy and helped physicians make more accurate decisions faster when used as an assistant. These findings support HCC-STAR as a reliable and verifiable decision-support system for risk stratification and precision therapy in HCC.
2607.08602.paper_summary_zh: 肝細胞癌（HCC）是一種常見的惡性腫瘤，也是癌症相關死亡的主要原因。當前的指導方針和分期系統提供了粗略的類別，但往往忽略了分期內的異質性和電子病歷（EMR）中的臨床背景。我們提出了HCC-STAR（肝細胞癌分期、治療和預後），這是一個臨床對齊的大型語言模型，能夠閱讀常規EMR敘述並共同輸出基於風險評分的分期、按證據基礎的合理性排名的指導方針一致的治療方案，以及個體化的生存預測。我們從SEER整理了約30,000個HCC病例，並使用臨床驗證的基於提示的增強工作流程將其擴展為EMR風格的敘述訓練數據。在這個語料庫上，我們開發了一個知識對齊的推理框架，並用步驟可驗證的綜合獎勵進行優化，超越了對臨床指導方針的文本級記憶。在來自中國12家醫院的6,668名患者的多中心隊列中，HCC-STAR在治療建議和風險分層方面達到了與臨床指導方針和競爭模型（包括GPT-5和Gemini-2.5 Pro）相比的最先進表現。假設的整體生存分析顯示，在遵循HCC-STAR建議的情況下，媒介生存期為51個月，而在BCLC和CNLC下分別為29個月和32個月。在以臨床醫生為中心的評估中，盲測的肝膽專家將HCC-STAR的推理和基於證據的理由評價為值得信賴。該模型在治療準確性方面超越了住院醫師和主治醫師，並在作為助手使用時幫助醫生更快地做出更準確的決策。這些發現支持HCC-STAR作為一個可靠且可驗證的決策支持系統，用於HCC的風險分層和精準治療。
